votes.description: The Board approved the meeting minutes from the February 13, 2024 RDA meeting.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 03 of 2024 (Annual Housing Funding Priorities Fiscal Year 2024-25)
votes.description: The Board adopted a resolution establishing the Affordable Housing Funding Priorities for Fiscal Year 2024-25, which guide the upcoming fiscal year's housing activities including requirements for the competitive affordable housing Notice of Funding Availability.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 04 of 2024 (RDA Budget Amendment No.2 for Fiscal Year 2023-24)
votes.description: The Board adopted a resolution amending the final budget of the Redevelopment Agency for FY2023-24, re-appropriating funding for projects in the Depot District and Station Center areas and consolidating appropriations to align with the City's new Workday financial system.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 05 of 2024 (Renaming of the Redevelopment Agency of Salt Lake City)
votes.description: The Board adopted a resolution renaming the Redevelopment Agency of Salt Lake City to the Salt Lake City Community Reinvestment Agency, aligning with changes to state law governing such agencies.
The Board approved setting dates for a public hearing and action on the RDA FY2024-25 budget and RDA Budget Amendment No.3 for FY2023-24.
